name: Shenzhen CDL Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen CDL Precision Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer and distributor specializing in essential functional, structural, and optical components tailored for the consumer electronics industry. The company's extensive portfolio encompasses a diverse range of functional devices, including solutions for adhesion and securement, cushioning and sealing, electrical conductivity and shielding, insulation, and thermal management. Furthermore, it supplies specialized products such as optical protective films, fine mesh dust filters, various labels, packaging materials, composite mobile phone covers, camera flash diffusers, and earpiece grilles. These components are integral to a wide array of devices, including smartphones, tablet computers, and other digital communication products. Founded in Shenzhen, China, in 2004, the enterprise operated as CDL Sticky Products (Shen Zhen) CO.,LTD. before officially adopting its current name in 2013.
